changelog.0.1.0: Initial C++ application scaffold with spectrogram + DINOv3 signal detector flow
changelog.0.2.0: Added selectable coherent-power detector scaffolding alongside the existing DINOv3 path
changelog.1.0.0: Release: coherent-power + zero-shot DINOv3 + fine-tuned DINOv3 (M5-S) detectors, signal snipper + SigMF sink, live dashboard, offline dataset preprocessing, DGX Spark (aarch64) support
changelog.1.5.0: Fine-tuned DINOv3 M7-S (multi-rate / multi-scenario retrain, 5-500 MSps) replaces M5-S everywhere (demo switch, loopback, offline eval, preprocessing); real-time DINO-FT pipeline sustains 245.76 MSps; short-FFT front end; scenario generator + any-rate SigMF eval tools
changelog.1.5.1: USRP N320 live support for preliminary testing (radio script --antenna / KEEP_HDR, N320 spp port fix); M7-S configs validated live on the N320 at 245.76 MSps single and 2 x 122.88 MSps dual
